coadaptation.title: Assistance & co-adaptation
coadaptation.subtitle: Tries different kinds of selection help inside Heliox's own study area and estimates which suits you. After a few sessions the estimate still rests mostly on general data.
coadaptation.authority_note: Changes how targets are shown and what a selection needs from you. It never approves, clicks or runs anything for you; permissions and approval dialogs are unchanged.
coadaptation.older_daemon: This app is connected to an older Heliox daemon. Restart the daemon, then retry.
coadaptation.keyring_unavailable: Secure key storage is unavailable on this system, so co-adaptation stays off.
coadaptation.unavailable: Co-adaptation is unavailable on this daemon.

consent.title: Assistance study: how Heliox helps you select things
consent.intro: Heliox can run a short selection study inside its own window. It measures how you select targets and menu items, tries different kinds of help, and estimates which help suits you. After a few sessions that estimate still rests mostly on general data about how people select, not on yours. You can stop at any time.
consent.measured: What is measured: when and where you click, tap, pinch or press keys inside the study area; which target you selected; how long it took; corrections; your answers to short questions about effort and control. Movement is reduced to summaries (time, path length, number of corrections, peak speed) at the end of each trial. If you type a name for your profile, it is stored encrypted with your study data.
consent.not_measured: What is never stored: video, camera images, hand landmarks, eye images, raw mouse paths, typed text, voice, screen contents or window titles. Nothing outside the study area is measured, and nothing about Heliox's approval dialogs is stored.
consent.where: Where it is kept: only on this device, encrypted with a key held by your operating system's secure storage. Nothing is uploaded. Anyone who uses Heliox on this device can open Settings and view or erase it.
consent.purposes_note: Choose what you allow. The first item is required for the study; everything else is optional and off until you tick it.

selection_study.label: Run the selection study
selection_study.detail: Store study trials, Heliox's choices and your ratings.

adaptive_assistance.label: Let Heliox adapt during later sessions
adaptive_assistance.detail: From your second session, Heliox picks help using its current estimate for you, within your rules. For comparison, some blocks of those sessions use standard selection, and some use the help that scored best in your first session's study results.

cross_session_learning.label: Remember across sessions
cross_session_learning.detail: Keep what Heliox learned about your selections from one day to the next. Without this, every session starts fresh.

gaze_prior.label: Use coarse gaze direction
gaze_prior.detail: Use the left/right/up/down/centre gaze region as a hint about which target you mean. Gaze never selects anything. While a study session runs, gaze stays inside the study: it is not sent to Heliox's activity log. Only the gaze region and how sure the tracker was at each selection, and your gaze-check score, are stored, with your study data.

hand_pointer.label: Use the hand pointer
hand_pointer.detail: Point with your hand inside the study area. Only hand-tracking quality summaries are stored.

research_export.label: Allow encrypted export
research_export.detail: Let you save an encrypted copy of your study data on this device for analysis.

consent.retention: Your data is erased automatically after the period you choose (default 90 days), or immediately when you withdraw.
consent.nonclinical: This is not a medical or clinical tool. It does not diagnose, screen for or measure any health condition.
consent.rights: You can pause, stop, view your results, change your rules or erase everything at any time from Settings. Withdrawing erases all study data and the rules you set for this profile. Rules you set for everyone on this device stay until you remove them. If you later untick an optional item, what was stored only for it is deleted; changing your choices never keeps your data longer than the period you first chose.
consent.authority: Heliox only changes how targets are shown and what a selection needs from you. It never approves, clicks or runs anything for you, and your permissions and approval dialogs are unchanged.
consent.english_only_notice: The consent text is in English.
consent.label_hint: At most 32 characters. Stored encrypted with the study data and shown only on this device.
consent.update_deletion_note: Unticking an item deletes what was stored only for it. Your data are still erased on {expires_at}; updating never extends that date.

deletes.adaptive_assistance: Nothing is stored only for this item; later sessions run without adaptive blocks.
deletes.cross_session_learning: Nothing is stored only for this item; the next session starts fresh.
deletes.gaze_prior: Your gaze-check score and the gaze region stored with each selection.
deletes.research_export: Every encrypted export saved for this profile.

consent.session_open_untick: Stop the running session before removing a permission.

participants.title: Participants and consent
participants.withdraw_confirm: This erases all study data for this participant and deletes the rules set only for them. Rules set for everyone on this device stay.
participants.withdraw_key_pending: The study data was erased, but this participant's key is still in secure key storage. Heliox deletes it when key storage can be reached again: at its next start or the next time this panel refreshes.
participants.withdraw_files_pending: The study data was erased, but an export file or a rule for this participant could not be deleted yet. Heliox tries again at its next start and each time this panel refreshes.
participants.device_note: Anyone using Heliox on this device can see and erase these participants.

options.title: Options
options.advanced_note: Changes apply from the next study session. Study sessions always use the study protocol's exploration floor and switching penalty, and take your ambiguity threshold, slip tolerance or slip bound credibility only where it is stricter than the protocol's.
options.ambiguity_threshold_hint: Between 0.05 and 0.25. It can only be lowered from 0.25, which makes Heliox ask or wait more often.
options.burden_prompt_every_blocks: Ask about effort every n blocks

rules.title: My assistance rules
rules.intro: Your rules always win over what Heliox has learned. Heliox never writes a rule for you.

kind.pin_act: Always select exactly what I click

rules.pin_act_detail: An ambiguous click selects what it hits, and Heliox never adds a confirm step or a question for it.
rules.max_interruptions_copy: At most {n} extra steps per block. A confirm or hold step counts once per selection, even if you cancel or let go and try again; each question and each extra confirm Heliox adds counts.
rules.cap_min_caution_note: Your minimum caution leaves only confirm or hold steps, so your step limit does not remove them. Both rules stay as you set them.
rules.scope_participant: Only this participant (deleted when they withdraw)
rules.scope_device: Everyone on this device (kept after withdrawal)
rules.context_all: In the study and any later Heliox surface that reads these rules

summary.pin_act: Always select exactly what I click
summary.max_interruptions_per_block: At most {value} extra steps per block
summary.priorities: Priorities: fewer mistakes {mistakes}, faster {faster}, fewer interruptions {interruptions}
